capabilities: Track writing sessions in real time (words added, WPM, character counts, pauses)
Award XP and level progression from 1 to 900 across three tiers
Earn tier-based rewards via crops/animals or monster-slayer theme modes
Log daily energy levels and menstrual cycle phases
Export Markdown session reports to a designated vault folder
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Only 3 of the 900 levels' tiers exist so far. Installation is via BRAT or manual file placement; the README's BRAT steps reference a GitHub URL without including it.
motivation: The author built it because standard rigid writing advice leads to burnout for interest-driven writers, and wanted to replace shame-based productivity with rewards for every manuscript interaction.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to make writing progress feel rewarding or to account for fluctuating energy and cycle phases alongside word counts.

relations.evidence: inspired by Stardew Valley farming and D&D combat mechanics
Monster Slayer Mode (D&D Style): Slay Imps, Goblins, Trolls, and Dragons

summary: Gamified writing tracker that awards XP and levels for writing sessions, with crop/monster reward modes, energy and cycle logging, and auto-exported session logs.
